name: Selecting a different color variant updates displayed info

preconditions.note: Skip if product has no color variants

steps.script: (() => { const swatches = document.querySelectorAll('.csw .dot, .csw [class*="swatch"], [class*="color-chip"], [class*="variant-color"]'); return { hasVariants: swatches.length > 0, count: swatches.length }; })()
steps.description: Check if color variant selectors exist on the page
Click a different color variant swatch/chip if available
steps.snapshotHint: Look for color swatches/chips — clickable elements representing colors. Skip this step if none found.

businessContext: Color variants show different product options — critical for phones sold in multiple colors
